journal_lines: Pillager patrol. Took the long way around. Then didn't.
Outpost nearby. Picked off the one that wandered.
Better armed than expected. Still manageable.
Two in a clearing, three more out of sight. Counted again later.
A flag in their banner I did not recognize. Tore it down anyway.
Watched their watch-fire from a hill. Walked past while they argued.
One was older than the rest. Wore his coat like he had earned it. Maybe he had.
Crossbow bolt in the bark by my ear. The bark forgave it. I did not.
Found their songs scratched into a tree. Did not learn the tune.
They marched in step. They fell out of step.
Outpost tower from the ridge. Counted them in. Counted fewer out.
